pages.text: A small wall or ceiling light. Light $(bold)12$() for $(bold)50 W$().

pages.title: Power
pages.text: Link it with the $(l:power/binder)Binder$(/l) to your grid or a lone $(l:power/storage)Cell Dock$(/l).$(br2)Lights are shed before life support in a brownout.

pages.title: Use
pages.text: Empty-hand right-click switches it on or off. Off draws nothing.$(br2)Works without air and adds no room heat.

pages.title: Mounting
pages.text: Walls and ceilings only, on a solid face. Removing the support drops the lamp.$(br2)It doesn't seal a hole.
Iron, glass, redstone and copper. Makes two.
